summary: Ford Motor Credit Company LLC filed a routine Form 8-K reporting the issuance and sale of €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.645% notes due October 29, 2029, completed September 29, 2026. The notes were issued under the company's effective Form S-3 shelf registration statement and its Euro Medium-Term Notes program. A legal opinion from David J. Witten was filed as Exhibit 5, with his consent as Exhibit 23.1. This is an ordinary debt capital markets takedown by the issuer, not a special situation; no equity terms, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics apply.
